property_summary: After calling rely(address) with the deployer's address on a default-deployed contract, the auth() modifier in the reference allows the call (since wards[msg.sender] == 1 after construction) and sets wards[msg.sender] = 1 (unchanged), while in the buggy version the require (wards[msg.sender] == 0) reverts because the deployer already has wards == 1; thus calling rely again on the same address reverts in M but succeeds in P, observable via a try/catch on rely.
change_summary: Replace '== 1' with '== 0' in the require condition, so only users with ward value 0 are authorized.
